node.statement: Exact unitary membership. For A=P+g_V(P), exact product reversal and J^dagger=J give [V bold-dot(J+A)]^dagger=(J+A^dagger) bold-dot V^dagger, so the defining formula says X_V(P)^dagger bold-dot X_V(P)-J=2F(P,g_V(P))=0. Since ||P||,||g_V(P)||<2delta, ||A||<4delta; node 1.1.2 therefore makes L_{X_V(P)} invertible and in particular supplies a right inverse of X_V(P). By def-approximate-unitary-space these two facts say exactly X_V(P) lies in calU.
